mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT r.* FROM recipe r LEFT JOIN recipe_tag rt ON r.id = rt.recipe_id LEFT JOIN recipe_ingredient ri ON r.id = ri.recipe_id LEFT JOIN ingredient i ON ri.ingredient_id = i.id LEFT JOIN user u ON r.creator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_favorite uf ON r.id = uf.recipe_id LEFT JOIN recipe_cook rc ON r.id = rc.recipe_id
AND (r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recipe_tag WHERE recipe_id = r.id AND tag_type = #{tagType} AND tag_value = #{tagValue} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recipe_ingredient WHERE recipe_id = r.id AND ingredient_id IN
#{id}
)
AND r.creator_id = #{creatorId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_favorite WHERE recipe_id = r.id AND user_id = #{favoritedByUserId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recipe_cook WHERE recipe_id = r.id AND user_id = #{cookedByUserId} )
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{creatorUsername}, '%')
ORDER BY r.view_count DESC
ORDER BY r.favorite_count DESC
ORDER BY r.recently_cooked_count DESC, r.last_cooked_at DESC
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
